notes.subject: אפך
notes.rationale: Literally 'your nose/nostrils' — Hebrew's physical organ of anger; rendered 'dusu-jugu' (anger).

notes.subject: copula
notes.rationale: 'So is your wrath' — Hebrew juxtaposes without a verb; Bambara supplies 'de don'.

notes.subject: to Yawe
notes.rationale: The verse addresses Yawe directly with a question.

notes.subject: who knows
notes.rationale: A rhetorical question of withheld knowledge: the full force of the wrath cannot be known.

translation: Jɔn de bɛ i ka dusu-jugu fanga dɔn? I n'i ka siran cogo min na, i ka jalo de don.

tokens.gloss: i n'i ka siran cogo min na
